verdict.rationale: Sharing a research session or report with collaborators is a fair axis for an AI research engine, but nothing in the evidence pack documents it. Threads turn searches into conversations, and the organization plan offers centralized account management and billing, but neither shows sharing a session or report for others to view or build on. Those are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can share a research session or report with collaborators who can view or build on it
